home.sub: Replace WhatsApp, spreadsheets and calls with one live cockpit.
home.s1_title: You move goods from one city to another. That is the whole business.
home.s1_body: A customer needs a load carried. Your truck picks it up, a driver takes it there. Simple — until it isn't.
home.s2_sub: “Truck chahiye kal subah.” One call becomes ten.
home.s2_body: You ring drivers, compare rates, scribble prices on paper scraps and forward addresses on WhatsApp. Every booking lives in five different places — mostly in your head.
home.s3_title: The customer asks. You honestly don't know yet.
home.s3_body: Until the driver answers his phone, nobody knows if the truck is in traffic, parked at a dhaba, or lost. One truck is easy to track in your head. Twenty is chaos.
home.s4_sub: The trip finished — the paperwork didn't.
home.s4_body: Invoices wait to be made, fuel receipts vanish, and one payment quietly slips through the cracks. Multiply that by every trip this month.
home.s5_title: Avandab puts your transport business on one screen.
home.s5_body: Book a trip, assign a driver, share a live tracking link, get paid — each step flows into the next, automatically.
home.s5_f4: Every rupee in and out, recorded
home.ben_sub: No add-ons, no per-feature pricing — the complete toolkit ships together.
home.pov_title: One platform. Four points of view.
home.pov_sub: Everyone in the operation gets exactly the screen they need — nothing more, nothing missing.
home.pov_owner_d: Know profit per trip and spot fuel leaks — no spreadsheets, no guessing.
home.pov_ops_d: Book, assign and track every trip from one board — with alerts when something needs attention.
home.pov_driv_d: Trip details on mobile, delivery marked on the spot with a signed proof.
home.pov_cust_d: Self-serve shipment tracking and invoices — fewer status calls to your office.

sy.feat.cta_sub: Spin up your Avandab workspace and put this feature to work on your very next trip.
sy.feat.fa1: Most teams are running in the same day. Add your vehicles and drivers, and start creating trips — no hardware or training required to begin.
sy.feat.fa2: Data is encrypted in transit and at rest (AES-256), access is role-based, and every meaningful action is recorded in append-only audit logs. Data is hosted in India.
sy.feat.fa3: The web app works on any device with a browser. Drivers can use the mobile app for e-POD and status updates from any Android phone.
sy.feat.fa4: Invoices carry your company's GSTIN and tax details. Line items follow GST structure so your accountant can file without reformatting. CGST/SGST for in-state, IGST for inter-state.
sy.feat.fa5: Avandab scales from a handful of vehicles to hundreds. Start with a pilot, prove the value, and expand — no long-term contracts required.
